Leasing Consultant 
 About JLL 
 We're JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We shape the future of real estate for a better world by combining world-class services, advisory, and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people, and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers, and to find a place where they belong. Whether you've got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, or technology, or you're looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. 
 Position Overview 
 JLL is seeking a motivated and customer-focused Leasing Consultant to join our property management team. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for prospective residents, guiding them through the leasing journey while contributing to the overall marketing, leasing, and resident relations strategy at the property. The ideal candidate combines strong sales instincts with genuine relationship-building skills and thrives in a fast-paced, people-first environment. 
 What This Job Involves 
 Marketing and Leasing 
 You will perform the overall leasing and resident relations function at the property, evaluating and monitoring key metrics including vacancy, sales, renewals, move-ins, move-outs, notices, and rescinded notices. You will train, mentor, and support part-time and support staff at the property, and collaborate with the Leasing and Resident Experience Manager, Marketing, and Property Management teams to develop and implement sales and marketing plans. 
 Day-to-day, you will market and show available suites to prospective residents, managing the presentation of application forms to Property Management for approval. You will keep advertising, media channels, promotional programs, and signage current and accurate, and maintain the customer database to ensure all leads are responded to and all traffic is documented appropriately. 
 A comprehensive knowledge of the property is essential. You will be expected to know suite types and layouts, common areas, amenities, and value-added services, acting as a subject matter expert for colleagues across departments. You will coordinate with Property Management to ensure suites are delivered on time and as promised, and you will conduct move-in inspections and orientations with new residents. 
 You will contribute to content creation for the property's social media channels and other web-based marketing initiatives, which may include blogging and drafting responses to public inquiries for approval. Staying current on competitive buildings through quarterly market surveys will inform your feedback and recommendations on rental rates, promotions, and market conditions aimed at maximizing property revenue. You will also build and maintain relationships with community organizations and local businesses that enhance the resident experience and drive traffic to the property. 
 Resident Relations and Customer Experience 
 You will organize resident engagement and retention events tailored to your target market, with the goal of building lasting relationships with residents. You will also contribute content to the property's quarterly newsletter. 
 Reporting and Administration 
 Reporting on vacancy, traffic, and other key metrics will be a weekly responsibility. You will ensure timely and accurate completion and entry of all leasing documentation, including application forms, tenancy agreements, renewal agreements, and supporting documentation. 
 Customer Service 
 Maintaining strong resident relations is central to this role. You will address and document resident complaints and any building emergencies that occur during and outside regular office hours, and you will support broader efforts to ensure resident satisfaction through prompt service, ongoing communication, and consistent follow-up. 
 Sound Like You? To Apply, You Need To Have 
 You bring one to three years of relevant experience in leasing, real estate, property management, rental housing, or a customer-facing sales environment, ideally with prior exposure to residential rental properties or housing-related sales. 
 You are comfortable meeting prospective renters face-to-face and leading conversations independently, with a strong ability to build rapport, communicate value, and respond confidently to questions or concerns. 
 You are organized and capable of managing multiple appointments and follow-ups throughout the day, backed by strong verbal and written communication skills. 
 You are comfortable using Yardi CRM systems, digital forms, and mobile applications, and familiarity with rental advertising, property photography, or social media marketing is considered an asset. Given the nature of leasing activity, you have flexible availability, including evenings and weekends as needed. 
 What You Can Expect From Us 
 We succeed together—and we want you to grow and thrive with us. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to work with a team that is shaping the future of real estate. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your career ambitions, maintain physical and mental well-being, and find a true sense of belonging at JLL.

Role context

This role sits on the Growth Marketing team, which builds and runs the experimentation engine behind our next phase of customer acquisition. The team tests new channels, manages the test budget and scales what works. Core paid search is owned elsewhere, so your focus is everything beyond it.

The role

You will help run growth channels and new experiments to deliver MaintainX pipeline and build the future of core marketing investments, and grow into full ownership some channels.

 - Design and run structured tests across paid social, streaming audio, direct mail, programmatic and other emerging channels to find scalable channels at or below target CAC this year.

 - Manage a growing test budget, shifting spend toward what performs to improve efficiency, and take full ownership of 1–2 channels within 6–12 months.

 - Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to decide which experiments to scale, pivot or stop, and present those recommendations to Marketing and Sales leaders.

 - Use AI tools for creative testing, automation and optimization to increase test velocity while keeping human judgment on the calls that matter.

 - Build the testing frameworks and documentation that make every experiment faster to launch and every result easy to reuse.

You will partner with Creative, Sales and Product Marketing so each test fits our value propositions and the sales motion behind it, and you will learn directly from a senior growth leader. Within 12 months success can be defined by 1-2 channels owned end-to-end, tested and documented new channel performance, and at least one channel scaled beyond initial test budget.

About you

Must-haves

 - Hands-on experience running performance campaigns and budgets on paid social, programmatic, content syndication or similar demand channels

 - Experience co-managing $250-500K+ in annual performance marketing spend

 - A track record of structuring clean tests, measuring impact and making clear recommendations

 - Time in B2B growth or performance marketing, ideally SaaS

 - Working fluency in analytics tools and a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Analytics, Tableau) to pull insight and act on it

 - Practical experience using AI tools in campaign or creative workflows

Nice-to-haves

 - Experience with offline channels such as direct mail or streaming audio

 - Paid search (Google/Bing) experience (NOT part of role)

We offer

Work that shows up in the physical world. What our customers run on MaintainX keeps factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses up, and your tests help us reach more of the people who run them.

A product the industry already loves. You are growing something customers choose, renew and expand, so the question is where to find the next buyer, not whether anyone wants it.

An early seat, not an inherited one. The experimentation engine is being built right now, by a team small enough that you can name the channels you own.

Autodesk scale, same mission. We are now part of Autodesk, with global reach pointed at the problem we were already solving. Nobody arrived to change what we are building.

Values & how we work

We reward output. We promote quickly when people deliver, and we hire for what you have run, not what your title was. Tell us about a test you ran: what you tried, what the data said and what you did next. You get autonomy and the trust to use it, and we expect real engagement in return.

Thriving at Rewind:

The Senior Technical Support Engineer (T3) is the highest tier of our support organization, serving as a bridge between customer support and engineering. You will own the most complex, ambiguous technical escalations that our T1 and T2 teams cannot resolve - including issues that previously required involvement from the Engineering Run Team.

As the most senior member of the support team, you’ll also be its on-the-floor leader. You’ll make judgment calls, coach T1/T2 through tough situations, and help build this new tier from the ground up.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Technical Support Engineer, you will serve as the final escalation point within the support organization. You bring a software development background and deep technical instincts to diagnose root causes, reproduce edge cases, write or read code to understand issues at depth, and work directly with the Engineering team to drive resolution. This is not a traditional support role - you will spend a significant portion of your time doing technical investigation work that sits at the boundary of support and engineering.

This role requires participation on a on-call rotation including weekends and holidays.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the most complex technical escalations from T1 and T2, serving as the final line of defense.

 - Investigate and reproduce customer-reported bugs, data inconsistencies, and integration failures across Rewind's supported platforms (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Shopify, QuickBooks Online, and more)

 - Read and write code (primarily in the context of debugging and scripting) to diagnose issues, test hypotheses, and validate fixes

 - Work directly with Engineering to clearly articulate bugs, provide reproducible test cases, and track fixes through to resolution

 - Manage and resolve issues in customer environments involving API integrations, OAuth configurations, webhook failures, and platform-level permissions

 - Handle data restoration requests and complex recovery scenarios requiring deep knowledge of Rewind's backup architecture

 - Give direct, constructive feedback to T1/T2 team members when an escalation or error needs a course correction

 - Lead blameless postmortems that separate process gaps from individual coaching needs, and recommend clear options (training, process changes, guardrails)

 - Mentor and upskill T1/T2 through pairing, lunch-and-learns and escalation reviews, and set the bar for what a well-prepared escalation looks like

 - Help define the processes, SLAs and ways of working for Rewind’s new Enterprise Support tier as we build it from scratch

 - Own enterprise customer onboarding when required, including installation, deployment, and education, ensuring the customer is fully set up for success

 - Help build and maintain the internal knowledge base for complex issue patterns, enabling T1/T2 to self-serve future resolutions

 - Participate in on-call rotations for P1 incidents affecting enterprise customers

 - Identify recurring escalation patterns and proactively surface product improvement opportunities to Engineering and Product

WHAT YOU BRING

 Réapprovisionner les fournitures et veiller à ce que les espaces de préparation des aliments soient propres, organisés et hygiéniques.

 Qualifications 
 Une expérience préalable dans le secteur des services alimentaires ou dans un restaurant est un atout, mais n’est pas obligatoire.
 Excellentes aptitudes en service à la clientèle et attitude chaleureuse et courtoise.
 La connaissance des systèmes de point de vente (PDV), notamment Micros POS, constitue un atout.
 Bonnes compétences en calcul de base pour effectuer les transactions et manipuler les espèces avec précision.
 Capacité à gérer efficacement son temps dans un environnement de travail dynamique.
 Connaissance des normes de salubrité, d’hygiène et de manipulation sécuritaire des aliments.
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication et capacité à travailler en équipe.
 Capacité à rester debout pendant de longues périodes et à effectuer efficacement des tâches répétitives.
 Une expérience en préparation des aliments, en service, à la caisse ou dans les opérations de cuisine constitue un atout.
 Ce poste joue un rôle essentiel dans l’offre d’une expérience de restauration positive à nos clients, tout en maintenant des normes élevées de propreté, d’hygiène et de sécurité. Nous accueillons avec plaisir les personnes motivées qui souhaitent développer leurs compétences et évoluer dans le secteur de la restauration.
